sources.primary_title: Saudi Proptech Ghanem Raises $7.1M From Al-Romaih Group
sources.verified_angle_summary: Saudi proptech startup Ghanem has successfully raised $7.1 million from the Al-Romaih Group to accelerate the development and expansion of its digital fractional real estate ownership platform. Founded in 2025 by Saleh Al-Ghamdi and Amr Essam, Ghanem operates within the Regulatory Sandbox of the Saudi Real Estate General Authority (REGA). The capital injection aims to lower the entry barriers for individual and institutional investors in the Saudi real estate market, providing them with transparent and flexible investment opportunities. This move aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 objectives of digital transformation and real estate diversification. The funding will be utilized to expand product offerings, enhance technological infrastructure, and broaden the base of real estate investment across the Kingdom, marking a significant milestone in the democratization of property investment in Saudi Arabia.
